problems.problem: Opaque dark/green fringe under the bottle base reads as a hard stub rather than a soft contact shadow
problems.evidence: Image 6 row 1, contact crop: a saturated dark-green blob protrudes below the base curve onto the cloth
problems.root_cause: sRGB-space alpha matting left premultiplied edge RGB baked into the半transparent base rows
problems.repair: Re-composite base rows in linear light and replace the stub with a low-opacity elliptical contact occlusion

problems.problem: Label wrap edge shows a yellow-orange remnant sliver at left label border
problems.evidence: Image 6 row 1, label crop: ochre pixel column outside the white label keyline
problems.root_cause: Original-edge remnant from the source cutout retained in composite
problems.repair: Choke alpha 1px at label silhouette or inpaint the sliver with background grey

problems.problem: Contact occlusion under base is thinner than baseline, bottle floats slightly
problems.evidence: Image 6 row 2, contact crop: cloth directly beneath green base is nearly unshaded compared with row 1
problems.root_cause: Linear-light composite dropped the source contact darkening without substituting an occlusion term
problems.repair: Add a diffuse, near-vertical soft contact shadow matched to frontal fill light

problems.problem: Green base band reads over-saturated versus packshot source
problems.evidence: Image 6 row 2 vs image 5: base green brighter than the transparent original flattened neutral
problems.root_cause: Linear-light unpremultiply amplified saturated semi-transparent base pixels
problems.repair: Clamp base chroma to source flattened values before scene blend

problems.problem: Minor residual ochre sliver at left label edge persists from source
problems.evidence: Image 6 row 3, label crop: faint warm pixel at label keyline, identical to source defect

problems.problem: Neck glass highlights slightly milky versus source, weakening observed glass transmission
problems.evidence: Image 6 row 4, neck crop: empty-glass zone lighter and lower contrast than image 5
problems.root_cause: Frontal fill term added over glass instead of only over scene behind alpha
problems.repair: Apply scene light only through (1-alpha) so glass transmission stays source-identical

problems.problem: Contact shadow present but offset slightly camera-left of base center
problems.evidence: Image 6 row 4, contact crop: darkest occlusion not centered under base protrusion
problems.root_cause: Occlusion ellipse placed from bounding box rather than alpha centroid
problems.repair: Recenter occlusion on alpha-weighted base centroid

reason: B keeps bottle, cap, label and glass transmission closest to the transparent source (image 5), shows the cleanest linear-light edges without baseline's hard green stub, and its enlarged contact crop confirms a real soft occlusion consistent with diffuse frontal light; A floats and C milks the neck glass, while baseline carries fringe and stub defects.

next_repairs.action: Remove the 1px ochre source remnant with a local alpha choke, keeping label texture otherwise untouched
Optionally widen the soft occlusion 2-3px laterally for heavier packshot feel without introducing directional bias
